title: Migrate daemon test worlds off a policy-ALLOW precondition
description:
FILED BY governor-36414416 2026-08-23 19:23Z to execute the SPLIT ruled in comment-f4c41346 on task-064b97584aff4e07967738f79134a723. Filed by the governor rather than an architect only because no architect seat was responsive and task-064b9758 - the root of an eleven-row chain - cannot proceed until this row exists. The governor has NOT planned it: there is no implementationPlan here and the architect owns every step.

THE DEFECT THIS ROW REPAIRS. Forty daemon test suites currently require policy to ADMIT as a fixture PRECONDITION, for subjects unrelated to policy. They construct their world through an activation that must reach ALLOW, and when it does not they throw in WORLD SETUP and never reach their own assertions. Quoted chain: `Error: activation refused: BUDGET_LEDGER_TRANSITION_REFUSED` at journal-test-harness.ts:144 in openJournalHarness.

WHY THAT IS A DEFECT AND NOT AN INCONVENIENCE. Production is not entitled to produce that ALLOW. evaluatePolicy admits only on a fact that is BOTH tier-bearing AND strong-truth, and `git grep --untracked PolicyRiskTier -- apps/daemon/src` returns ZERO lines against a positive control of 5+ over packages/core/src/policy. No durable record carries a PolicyRiskTier. Governor ruling 3 (comment-df7840cf, QA-graded via task-e74d3116) holds that no policy risk fact is asserted until such a record exists, so the honest tier is null, assessRisk skips it, and evaluatePolicy folds to HOLD_UNKNOWN. A test world that can only be built by granting an authority the product does not have is a HARNESS defect. This row is repair, not accommodation - write the DoD that way.

MEASURED BLAST RADIUS, from worker-4e360d0c's probes (comment-390012be; probes restored, SHA256-verified, tree clean, baseline HEAD 2ef3bea = 222 files / 4817 passed + 1 todo):
- Semantic half alone - drop the tier-bearing fact at admission-witness-fixtures.ts:97, exactly what the resolver produces under ruling 3: 40 files / 620 tests failed.
- DoD 2 alone - "facts" appended to SERVER_SOURCED_KEYS, one line: 65 files / 1144 tests failed. That larger figure belongs to task-064b9758, not here.
This row is accountable to the 40 files / 620 tests figure. Re-measure it at current HEAD before planning; do not inherit the number.

SCOPE FENCE - all four are binding, from comment-f4c41346:
1. Does NOT touch the policy resolver and does NOT decide tier authority. Those are task-064b9758 and the human respectively.
2. May NOT migrate worlds to HUMAN_APPROVAL as a shortcut. task-064b9758 step 5 forbids it in terms and the prohibition is carried across.
3. May NOT weaken the refusal to "only tier-bearing caller facts". Measured to still admit fact-admission-risk, which is the exact defect task-064b9758 exists to close.
4. Must state its blast radius up front and reconcile the final count against its own re-measurement.

DOWNSTREAM: task-064b9758 is gated behind this row, and behind it sit eb6a1fa6 -> eacea969 -> d8bb8a98 -> 933605a5 -> 203a5ca7 -> a20e8ef6 -> e62e3828 / 89838d72 / 48c79a29. That is a reason for a correct, narrow, well-measured migration - NOT a reason to widen scope to unblock them faster.

IF THE MIGRATION CANNOT BE DONE WITHOUT CHANGES THIS ROW DOES NOT OWN: file the prerequisite and BLOCK. Do not invent an authority source, do not seed a tier, and do not grant the harnesses an ALLOW by another route.
definitionOfDone: VERIFY-OR-BLOCK FIRST: at the delivered tree, re-measure the harness-precondition failure set that results from the resolver's honest null-tier fact (the admission-witness-fixtures.ts:97 semantic half). Record the exact file and test counts and the failing harness entry points in a durable task comment. If the count materially differs from the measured 40 files / 620 tests baseline, say so and explain before planning further.

Every daemon test world that currently requires a policy ALLOW as a construction precondition builds WITHOUT one. The harnesses reach their own assertions rather than throwing in world setup; openJournalHarness at journal-test-harness.ts:144 and every sibling entry point in the measured set are covered.

No world is migrated to HUMAN_APPROVAL, no PolicyRiskTier is seeded, no durable record is invented to carry a tier, and no caller-supplied fact is admitted to obtain the ALLOW. A grep over the diff shows none of these escapes was used.
The policy resolver, policy.validate, and the caller-facts refusal are UNTOUCHED by this row's diff - they belong to task-064b9758. Any overlap is named and justified in the review summary.

Tests that genuinely assert policy admission behaviour still assert it, and are distinguished in the review summary from the harnesses that merely needed a world. A migration that silently deletes real policy coverage does not pass.

pnpm --filter @moe/daemon typecheck and pnpm --filter @moe/daemon test are each run as SEPARATE unpiped legs, both exit 0 with nonzero counts, and the final count is reconciled against this row's own DoD-0 re-measurement.
taskRails: Never grant a test world an authority production does not have. If a harness needs an ALLOW, the harness is wrong, not the policy path.
Do not touch the policy resolver, policy.validate, or the caller-facts refusal - task-064b9758 owns them.
HUMAN_APPROVAL migration is forbidden as a shortcut (carried from task-064b9758 step 5).
State the blast radius before changing bytes, and reconcile the final count against it.
If the migration needs changes this row does not own, file the prerequisite and BLOCK rather than widening scope.

3. BIDIRECTIONAL IMPORTER CENSUS. comments.content: PRE-PLAN FEASIBILITY WARNING, measured read-only at HEAD 2ef3bea78740 (no source bytes changed). `NODE_ADMISSION_GATE_POLICIES` has exactly POLICY_ALLOWANCE and HUMAN_APPROVAL; `resolveAdmissionGate` is the same binary branch. This row forbids HUMAN_APPROVAL. The named harness is not consuming a disposable boolean: `openJournalHarness` calls `activate`; `activate` calls the real `runEffectActivateCommand`, strict-reads its committed `ActivationLedgerRecord`, then commits a reservation from record.activationDigest/attempt/grant before opening the session. `runEffectActivateCommand` creates that record only after durable budget/claim/arm/activation/slot gates, then binds budget/resources. The only non-test writer of EffectActivationCommitted is `commitActivationLedgerRecord` through that ingress; `activation-ledger-fixtures.ts` is explicitly a fixture constructor. Therefore a plan that direct-seeds an ActivationLedgerRecord/grant/session/reservation would grant a test world authority production does not have and violate task rail 1. A compliant plan must name a real production seam by which each unrelated subject can be built without an admitted activation, or follow the row instruction to file a prerequisite and BLOCK. This is a warning, not a ruling; architect should verify/refute before planning.
